scripts.dev:remote: cp infra/.env.remote .dev.vars && npm run build && concurrently -n sdk,vite,api -c blue,green,yellow "tsdown --watch" "vite build --watch" "wrangler dev"
scripts.dev:local: npm run infra:local:up && cp infra/.env.local .dev.vars && npm run build && concurrently -n sdk,vite,api -c blue,green,yellow "tsdown --watch" "vite build --watch" "wrangler dev"
scripts.infra:local:up: podman machine start && podman compose --env-file infra/.env.local -f infra/local/compose.minio+valkey.yaml up -d
scripts.infra:local:down: podman compose --env-file infra/.env.local -f infra/local/compose.minio+valkey.yaml down -v && podman machine stop
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run typecheck
